evidence.reason: The fixture still creates its first commit without disabling inherited commit signing. With a global/user `commit.gpgSign=true`, Git tries to sign using the fixture committer identity `fixture@example.invalid`; if no matching signing key exists, the commit at line 94 fails and every `DeployTests` setUp errors. The fixture should set repository-local `commit.gpgSign=false` before this commit (or pass `-c commit.gpgSign=false`), which also covers later fixture commits.
